Victorian Style
Glass and Cast Metal Inkwell Set
Late 19th to Early 20th Century Style
This vintage desk set features a substantial clear glass dome inkwell housed within an ornate cast metal frame. Included is a coordinating fountain pen with a red barrel and black taper, providing a complete period-inspired desktop display.
Clear domed glass ink reservoir with hinged metal lid
Cast metal frame with integrated pen rack and decorative base
